label: Tanec · minutový s hudbou (LTX)
desc: Rychlejší a ostřejší varianta minutového tance s jednou souvislou skladbou. Podoba tváře se mezi střihy vlní.
desc_en: The faster, sharper take on the one-minute dance with one continuous piece of music. The facial likeness pulses between cuts.
soundtrack: she dances joyfully to the beat. Upbeat pop dance music with a clear steady rhythm, warm bass line and catchy synth melody.
style_tail: , static camera, natural room lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed
negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

beats.prompt: she breathes gently, chest rising once, then blinks slowly and opens her eyes again, and ends perfectly still
a warm smile slowly spreads across her face with a small tilt of the head, and she ends holding the smile
she starts to sway her hips gently side to side, arms loose and relaxed, feet in place, and ends mid-sway with weight centered
she steps to one side and shifts her weight onto that leg while both arms rise to shoulder height, and ends there
she turns halfway away from the camera and back again in one smooth motion, hair swinging with the turn, and ends facing the camera
she raises both arms above her head as her hips sway, head tilting once to each side, and ends with arms up
she lowers her arms slowly while rolling her shoulders back, hips still swaying, and ends with hands on her hips
she steps to the other side, weight shifting, one arm sweeping across her body, and ends with that arm extended
she spins once on the spot, hair swinging, and ends facing the camera with arms relaxed at her sides
the sway slows to a stop, she exhales and lets her shoulders drop, and ends standing still
she tucks a loose strand of hair behind her ear and looks at the camera, a smile forming, and holds
she laughs softly, eyes creasing, then settles into a warm steady gaze at the camera and stays still
